reports.title: APT28: Fancy Bear Credential Harvesting Against European Ministries
reports.raw_content: [THREAT ADVISORY #01] Security researchers observed threat actor APT28 executing the 'Fancy Bear Credential Harvesting Against European Ministries' campaign. Initial access was achieved by exploiting CVE-2023-23397. Once inside the internal network (such as local gateway 8.8.8.8), the malware verified connectivity against legitimate domain microsoft.com before establishing a Command-and-Control (C2) channel to malicious server 185.220.101.14 and domain login-gov-verify.com. Forensic analysis identified the payload SHA256 hash 01a9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c9b8a7f6e5d4c3b2a1f0e9d8c7b6a5f4e3d2c1b0a9 executing anomalous commands mapped to MITRE ATT&CK technique T1059.001.
